shifts.summary: Shift 1 on 2026-10-16 was reported as Easy to Moderate by candidates. Most reports did not specify overall difficulty or good attempts, but one source gave 75-80 overall good attempts. Questions covered general awareness, reasoning, quantitative aptitude, and English. Several GA questions repeated across sources, including the Forest Man of India and 1991 economic reforms. Some sources included answer keys alongside the questions.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: Topics included active-passive voice, idioms, one-word substitution, and synonyms. Odd one out questions on legislative bodies were also reported.

sections.name: General Awareness
sections.notes: Heavy coverage of current affairs, constitutional law, and static GK. Repeated themes included BNS section 103, MC Mary Kom, Neolithic sites, and 1991 reforms.

topics.topic: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan 2.0

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Questions focused on ratio and LCM, simple interest, and divisibility. One question involved finding values for divisibility by 72.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: Covered active voice, misspelled words, idiom meanings, synonyms, and word meanings. Spelling questions appeared frequently.

asked.q: Which among the following is known as the Forest Man of India?
Find the odd one out among the four options: Supreme Court, Vidhan Sabha, Rajya Sabha, Lok Sabha
After the 1991 economic reforms, in which sector did the Indian economy experience the most significant positive impact?
If laptop sales need to be increased in a market, which business or economic strategy would be most effective?
In which city of India was the 2025 Men's Hockey Asia Cup held?
If a six-digit number 45x72y is completely divisible by 72, what is the value of x + y?
What is the name of the famous Indian boxer who made history by winning the World Boxing Championship a record six times?
Which of the following archaeological sites is famous for Neolithic sites excavated in the state of Tamil Nadu?
Which two districts of West Bengal are known as the major maize production producing region?
What is the correct meaning of the English idiom 'Chips on One Shoulder'?
Which of the following words is misspelt?
Which offense is specifically addressed under section 103 of the BNS in relation to mob lynching?
Which country hosted the 2025 IC Women's Cricket World Cup?
Which Indian boxer holds the record for winning six world boxing championship titles?

observations: Multiple sources repeated similar GA questions, indicating topic emphasis.
Answer keys were provided in some video reports alongside questions.
English section had a high number of spelling and idiom questions.
Quantitative aptitude focused on basic arithmetic and divisibility rules.
disagreements: Some sources listed the 2025 Men's Hockey Asia Cup in Rajgir, while others asked without specifying the city.
Spelling questions had conflicting correct answers across sources (sycophant vs positive vs quicken).
Neolithic site questions varied between Paiyampalli and Burzahom as answers.
Economic reforms impact questions gave different sector answers (international trade vs import of cheap goods).

shifts.summary: Shift 2 was reported as Moderate to Difficult overall, with candidates saying General Awareness and Quantitative Aptitude were the toughest sections. Reasoning was rated Moderate to Difficult, while English was Moderate to Difficult. Most reports indicated a challenging paper, though some sources called it Easy to Moderate.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: Reported as doable but with timing concerns in some sources.

sections.name: General Awareness
sections.notes: Stuck to fixed topics, no article-based questions reported.

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Time management was a struggle, with DI skipped entirely and trigonometry considered weak.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: Reported as doable but lengthy and time-consuming.

asked.q: Two questions on 1991 economic reforms
Paleolithic sites from Ancient History
One Neolithic site from Jammu and Kashmir
One Neolithic site from Tamil Nadu
One appointment question in Current Affairs
One sports event location question in Current Affairs
One environment question on why it is in danger
Four Data Interpretation questions, one per set
Trigonometry questions
Bhim Singh Bhavesh, awarded Padma Shri in 2025 for contribution to social work, belongs to which state?
Which statement best describes the structural shift in the Indian economy as a major impact of 1991 economic reforms?
Before appointing a judge to the Supreme Court or High Court, consultation advice is mandatory for the President of India under which constitutional article?
The 10th Schedule of the Constitution of India is popularly known as?

observations: General Awareness was reported as the most difficult section.
Quantitative Aptitude had time management issues, with DI skipped entirely.
Reasoning was considered doable but with timing concerns.
English was lengthy and time-consuming despite being rated easier by some sources.
disagreements: 4 reports called Quant difficult, 1 called it very difficult.
Some sources rated the overall paper Easy to Moderate, while others rated it Moderate to Difficult.

shifts.summary: The 2026-10-16 Shift 3 exam was reported as easy to moderate overall. Candidates said the pattern matched previous years, except for sectional timing. No technical issues were reported. Students who practiced previous years' papers were expected to perform well.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: Reported as time-consuming but easy; candidates who prepared genuinely could score 50-60.

sections.name: General Awareness
sections.notes: Current affairs from the last six months; polity focused on articles. One question on Article 124 and the Supreme Court, and one on the Charter Act of 1791.

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Reported as normal difficulty but calculative and lengthy; required good practice to attempt 23+ questions.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: Some errors and slightly lengthy questions were reported.

asked.q: Two current affairs questions, one from 2025 and one from last year.
Two questions on Polity from the Constitution, including Article 124 related to the Supreme Court.
One question on the Charter Act of 1791.
Two questions on Articles.
Direct and indirect speech questions.
Antonyms and synonyms questions.
Paragraph-based questions, PQR S, and cloze tests.

observations: Pattern was the same as previous years, except for sectional timing.
No technical issues were reported; everything was smooth.
Quant was reported as easy but time-consuming and calculative.
English had some errors and slightly lengthy questions.

intro: The SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam held on 16 October 2026 has been analysed based on candidate feedback across shifts. Shift 1 was reported as Easy to Moderate, with one source indicating 75-80 overall good attempts. Shift 2 was described as Moderate to Difficult, with General Awareness and Quantitative Aptitude cited as the toughest sections. Shift 3 has a limited review available, suggesting an Easy to Moderate level, though more evidence is needed. The figures mentioned are unofficial, and SSC normalises scores across shifts.
